email.description: Must be globally unique across all Connect AI orgs.

last_name.description: The user's last name. Omit for users with a single name.

external_id.description: Idempotency key supplied by the calling system (for example, an HR system employee ID or Terraform resource ID). A second POST with the same key returns the existing user instead of creating a duplicate. Connect AI does not generate this value; the caller provides it.
